fact: Decree 2023-038/PRE institutes the public procurement e-portal, hosted by the CNMP and secured by ANSIE, and requires contracting authorities to publish tender notices, tender documents and cancellations on it.

The state broadcaster RTD reported that the electronic public procurement portal, launched in May 2023, publishes tenders and results, lets users consult files and gives access to the procurement commission's annual reports.
RTD reported that since 2021 the electronic procurement portal lists 1,300 published contracts and 1,227 recorded awards.
